newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Supersol a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Supersol a buy.

text.p: Lehman Brothers has assigned Israel's Supersol Ltd, a food retailer, a 1-buy rating and has set a target price for the end of 1997 of 94 shekels a share, Lehman said in a report released on Tuesday.

"The company is launching an aggressive investment programme to capture additional market share and secure its place as the number one supermarket retailer in the country," analyst Elise Horowitz said.

She forecast earnings per share would grow 9.6 percent in 1997 to 6.45 shekels and 16.1 percent in 1998 to 7.49 shekels, even though Supersol's operating margin is expected to fall slightly to 4.5 percent in the two years from an estimated 4.7 percent in 1996.

Horowitz noted that Israeli supermarkets have a lower market-penetration rate than chains in the United States or Western Europe, but she estimated it would grow to 56 percent over the next five years from the current 40 percent.
She said Supersol is launching an aggressive investment programme, which should enable it to boost its market share to 40 percent from 35 percent.
